scope: Which model judged each SL-4 evidence artifact, and one misattributed descriptive field in the hosted artifacts. The artifacts named here are historical and remain byte-identical: this addendum records what they literally say and what is established instead from the owning sources, and claims no more certainty than those sources support.

conventions.fileHash: sha256 of the committed file content (git show <commit>:<path>), byte-identical to what each run wrote. A Windows checkout with core.autocrlf=true rewrites line endings in the working copy, so hash the committed blob, not a checked-out file.
conventions.rowIdentity: Hosted rows are cited as sha256:<first 16 hex of sha256(row id)>, the verifier's own redaction convention. No raw identifier appears.

artifacts.role: canonical hosted verification — read-only, merged main @ f4afa91, corrected settlement check
the same rows re-verified from the verifier-fix branch before it merged
the first hosted verification, by the pre-fix settlement check — provenance only

hostedWriter.whyIncomplete: The verify phase calls no model. The expression describes an override variable in the verifier's own process, which was unset; it does not identify the model that produced the reconsiderations being verified.

evalWriter.whyIncomplete: The judge's model is resolved when the judge module is imported (RELATIONSHIP_SUPERVISOR_MODEL_ID = override, else the default), before the runner loads apps/web/.env.local; the label was read from the environment afterwards, at write time. It records the override variable's state, not the judge's model.

hostedReconsiderations.source: payload_jsonb.model_id on each canonical supervisor_reconsidered event of run sl4-2026-09-09b in hosted staging (project wdtjqlbsxwiijasicint), read-only, 2026-09-13
hostedReconsiderations.writtenBy: the judge's own modelId (NextWorkJudge.modelId = RELATIONSHIP_SUPERVISOR_MODEL_ID, resolved at import) — the attribution added by commit 7036b45 (PR #40)
hostedReconsiderations.establishes: the model the judge requested from OpenRouter for each reconsideration; the request names a single model and no fallback list
hostedReconsiderations.doesNotEstablish: a provider-side confirmation of the model served — the response's model field was not recorded
limits: The Day-1 rows were written 6 m 21 s before commit 7036b45 was created, by the working tree it was committed from. They carry model_id, which only that change writes, so the attribution change was present; byte-identity of that working tree to 7036b45 is not provable from Git. Days 2 and 3 ran supervisor, types, db and verifier code byte-identical to 7036b45.
The discarded run sl4-2026-09-09 recorded model_id = null on both its reconsiderations (sha256:831719f4b8caaef5, sha256:822b0efd5e4bfb4d). That is why it was discarded; it is not evidence.

evalBatches.basis: inferred from committed configuration and the artifacts' own label — not recorded by the runs
reasoning: The label "default (configuration)" is written only when process.env.RELATIONSHIP_SUPERVISOR_MODEL_ID is undefined at write time; an empty value would have been written as "".
Between import and write the runner only adds environment keys — loadWebEnvLocal never overwrites or removes one — so the override was also undefined when the judge resolved its model at import.
With the override undefined, RELATIONSHIP_SUPERVISOR_MODEL_ID resolves to DEFAULT_RELATIONSHIP_SUPERVISOR_MODEL_ID (packages/agent/src/model.ts).

DEFAULT_RELATIONSHIP_SUPERVISOR_MODEL_ID = "openai/gpt-5.4-mini" was introduced in commit 8298df8, and no commit on any ref has changed it since; it holds that value in both commits that bracket the runs.
limits: Both batches ran from an uncommitted working tree 7–10 minutes before 6e8bfdd was committed; the constant's value there is inferred from the commits on either side, not recorded.
No ai_usage_events rows exist for the runs (metering was off) and the provider's served-model field was not recorded, so no runtime record independently confirms the model.

The judge the eval exercised differs from the judge that ran hosted only by the modelId attribution property added in 7036b45; its prompt, schema and behaviour are unchanged, and the eval calls the judge alone, not the executor.

misattributedYieldPosture.cause: settlements.find((s) => s.payload.wake_key === r.payload.wake_key) keyed on the wake key alone. Both Cases woken on a day share it, and find() returned the quiescent Case's settlement first.
misattributedYieldPosture.impact: Descriptive only. None of the 22 hosted checks reads this field, so every check result stands; each hosted artifact misdescribes 3 of its 6 entries.
